news.title: Russia Turns to Arctic WW2 Route to Export Grain
news.summary: Russia, the world's largest wheat exporter, has turned to an Arctic World War II shipping route to export grain for the first time as the conflict in Ukraine stalls Black Sea trade and officials warn of risks in the NATO-controlled Baltic Sea.

news.title: Russia To Begin Year-Round Arctic Northern Sea Route Shipping in Early 2027
news.summary: Russia expects to begin regular year-round eastbound shipping along the Northern Sea Route in early 2027, as additional nuclear icebreaker capacity, newer ice-class LNG carriers and pressure to redirect energy exports toward Asia bring the long-delayed ambition closer to reality.

news.title: Drones Hit Container Ship off Bulgaria, Crew Safe and Ashore
news.summary: Sea drones struck a container ship off Bulgaria's Black Sea coast on Wednesday, the ship's owner and the government said, the latest in a string of attacks that have raised concerns about the growing scope of Russia's war in Ukraine.
